title: Actual two-noise observation and finite A1 accuracy budget

target_statement: For the explicit RGO history state, any probability base mu, positive measurable beta,kappa,tau and nonnegative measurable eta, set a=(eta+tau)/beta. Construct the actual ideal T,H first. For every Markov smoothed output M and terminal L, construct a measurable Markov Q with fibers GaussianSmoothing(M(s),sqrt(tau(s)/beta(s))) and the actual finite RGO P,R. Fix J and Delta>=0 and set eps(s)^2=2*tau(s)*Delta^2/(kappa(s)*(J+1)). From the actual A1 squared-W2 bound between M(s) and GaussianSmoothing(T(s),sqrt(eta(s)/beta(s))) at every continuing state, derive KL(Q(s)||H(s))<=Delta^2/(J+1), then for every n,s derive KL(R_n(s)||T(s))<=n*Delta^2/(J+1)+integral KL(L(x)||T(x)) d(P^n(s)). Show actual update and recursion, all Markov semantics and actual Gaussian semigroup; no assumed observation KL or posterior consistency.
